marketplaces.name: claude-plugins-official
marketplaces.note: Official marketplace; usually pre-registered. Browse with /plugin.

items.title: QMD - local markdown/code search (MCP)
items.description: Local BM25 + vector search over indexed folders, exposed as an MCP server and skill. Lets agents search a codebase semantically.

items.title: RTK - Rust Token Killer
items.description: CLI proxy that compresses Bash output to save tokens. A PreToolUse hook rewrites commands transparently.
hooks: claude/hooks/rtk.json (fallback if rtk init does not patch settings)

optionalHooks.description: Blocks commits whose command or message mention Claude or Anthropic. Use in workspaces where that is unwanted.
At the end of each turn, reminds Claude to update .claude/plans/backlog.md.
Re-index QMD collections on session start, and after turns that edited files in a mapped repo.

optionalSkills.description: Draft PR title/description from git history and a PR template.
Blank skill to copy when writing a new one (install only if the user wants it).

extras.description: Global instructions and base settings (model, effort, notifications).
Safe read-only git allowlist for settings.local.json.
